instruction:
In BRL-CAD, open /home/user/Desktop/body.step and /home/user/Desktop/drill.step. Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). For the steps below, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `body.step`.

Use the same cylindrical drill tool for two cuts: first cut a through hole with its axis along X and centerline passing through (45,30,15); second cut a through hole with its axis along Y and centerline passing through (60,45,15). Add a 20 x 20 x 10 mm square boss at the top center of the body. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl.
